item.title: Implement ledger.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request (verbatim): "Implement `ledger.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Goal: make ledger.py match SPEC.md exactly. Preserve the documented API. Handle every error and boundary case the spec names. Extend test_ledger.py with focused tests for each specified error and boundary case; the existing tests cover basics only. Use only the Python standard library. Commit the work on the local branch; do not push.

Acceptance criteria: every behaviour in SPEC.md is implemented and covered by a test; the full test suite passes with the standard library runner; no public API signature changes.

evidence.caption: Before: the stub fails both existing tests

pr.body: Approach: one threading.Lock guards all Ledger state. transfer() validates the amount, then checks accounts (KeyError), then either returns the same-account funds check or runs _move (insufficient funds and destination overflow return False before any write). Input dict and snapshots are copied. Validation helpers reject bool and float via exact type checks. Key files: ledger.py, test_ledger.py. Checks: python3 -m unittest, 29 tests OK on 993d644. Concurrency tests use fixed thread counts, join with a 30s timeout, and fail on hang. Assumptions: unhashable account names raise TypeError from the dict lookup (SPEC.md does not define this case). Public API is unchanged.
pr.summary: made Ledger match SPEC.md: validated construction, atomic locked transfers, copied snapshots. now every spec error and boundary case has a test. before: both methods raised NotImplementedError; now: 29 tests pass.
pr.title: Implement Ledger per SPEC.md with focused tests

agt_01M88W896FB0HF4NPSX41A6XGJ:1.description: Unhashable account names (list/dict) passed to transfer() raise TypeError from the dict membership test instead of KeyError or a documented error. SPEC.md does not define this case, so it is not a spec violation. at ledger.py:64

agt_01M88W896FB0HF4NPSX41A6XGJ:2.description: _validate_name accepts str subclasses, so a subclass name is stored and works. Harmless, but it is looser than the 'built-in' wording used for integers. at ledger.py:9

agt_01M88W896FB0HF4NPSX41A6XGJ:3.description: test_opposite_transfers_do_not_deadlock only asserts the total sum; it does not assert that the transfers succeeded. The test is correct, but it is weak. at test_ledger.py:165

risk.why: Concurrency/locking in a new module with no existing callers; no persistence or migration. Reviewer agt_01M88W896FB0HF4NPSX41A6XGJ confirmed high risk and passed the head.
